messages:
Leah Kim: Idea: benchmark post organized as a 'path map' for buyers. Two short lanes: 'Realtime feedback' and 'Bulk throughput'. each lane = 1 tiny chart + 1 CTA. quick thumbs?
Omar Ruiz: yes, and tie CTAs to tracking segments: devs -> instant sandbox, platform -> request capacity review. we should show conversion target per path.
Tara Singh: copy samples: 'Realtime feedback: prototypes that feel instant' and 'Bulk throughput: economical processing at scale'. keep microcopy <10 words.
Gabe Lin: I'll mock 2-panel visual. give me sample numbers for p50/tokens/sec/$ so I can label axes.
Omar Ruiz (data): small CSV for labels: ```
path,p50_ms,tokens_sec,cost_per_1k
realtime,65,150,9.8
balanced,200,900,4.2
bulk,620,2800,1.5
```
Leah Kim: nice. also add a tiny inset showing model deltas (fp16 vs 8-bit) and a sentence on fallback routing. e.g., 'If p50 > 180ms, route to dedicated pool or offer scheduling.'
Tara Singh: webinar plan: 2-min open with product story, 3-min demo switching from realtime to a 5k-doc batch, 90s unit-econ walk-through. CTA in follow-up: 1) Try instant demo (utm=path=realtime) 2) Book throughput review (utm=path=bulk).
Gabe Lin: tone note: avoid 'cheapest'. use 'economical', 'predictable unit cost', 'SLA-backed fastpath'.
ops-bot: Reminder: content-review scheduled 11:00 PST today.
Leah Kim: action items: Gabe upload mock + annotated CSV by 5pm, Omar finalize numbers and conversion targets, Tara draft two post variants (story-first + quick-data) and two subject lines to A/B test. review at 11. Thanks! :sparkles:
